mapper.sql: MENU_ID, PARENT_MENU_ID, MENU_NM, RTRIM(MENU_TYPE) AS MENU_TYPE, MENU_PATH, SORT_NO, RTRIM(USE_YN) AS USE_YN, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SCR_MENU ORDER BY SORT_NO, MENU_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SCR_MENU ( MENU_ID, PARENT_MENU_ID, MENU_NM, MENU_TYPE, MENU_PATH, SORT_NO, USE_YN, CRT_DTM, CRT_CMENO, LSCHG_DTM, LS_CMENO ) VALUES ( #{menuId}, #{parentMenuId}, #{menuNm}, #{menuType}, #{menuPath}, #{sortNo}, #{useYn}, #{crtDtm}, #{crtCmeno}, #{lschgDtm}, #{lsCmeno} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SCR_MENU SET MENU_NM = #{menuNm}, MENU_PATH = #{menuPath}, SORT_NO = #{sortNo}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, LSCHG_DTM = #{lschgDtm}, LS_CMENO = #{lsCmeno} WHERE MENU_ID = #{menuId}
